object:black dragon scale mail.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a front-facing dragon-hide armor torso with broad shoulder scales, a tapered waist, and layered central plates in near-black charcoal with muted gray facets. The teal pattern behind it is background.
object:black dragon scale mail.wikiDescription: The wiki classifies black dragon scale mail as dragon-hide body armor linked to the corresponding dragon color. The article does not determine the cut or pixel palette of this sprite.
object:black dragon scale mail.modelBrief: Build a compact scaled cuirass with broad raised shoulders and central rows of layered plates; use near-black charcoal with muted gray facets. Reuse the common dragon-mail shape across color variants, preserving this tile's distinct highlights.

object:gray dragon scales.modelBrief: Build a small loose cluster of overlapping thick pointed scales in olive gray and beige, with no torso frame. Keep it visibly separate from the fitted scale-mail cuirass of the same color.
